Slop Transcribe · Beta

Voice and audio to text

Voice, MP3 or video to text, on your device. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Slop Transcribe has these main features: Record your voice, or add MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC or video files, several at once; Whisper speech to text on this device, in 99 languages or detected. It opens Audio, Video.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Slop Transcribe

  • Transcribe audio to text: MP3, WAV, M4A and more
  • Transcribe a video to text
  • Make subtitles (SRT or VTT) from a video
  • A free Otter.ai alternative that keeps your audio on your device
